verdict.rationale: Motion documents some natural-language entry points: creating tasks by voice that the AI then schedules, telling Siri to add tasks, and forwarding emails that become scheduled tasks. It also lists an AI Search Assistant for finding items and an AI Workflow Builder that builds workflows from SOPs. The evidence covers only narrow input paths (mostly task capture), not general operation of the product by natural-language command. missing for 10: a documented conversational or command interface for operating the product broadly (rescheduling, editing projects, managing the calendar by NL), detail on how the AI Search Assistant handles natural-language queries, independent or hands-on corroboration.
